channel.title: Pier & Point · 1700 Owens Street
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for 1700 Owens Street (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · 1700 Owens Street: The 1700 Owens page said UCSF's Center for AIDS Research lists…
item.description: The 1700 Owens page said UCSF's Center for AIDS Research lists events held at this address. The linked page is an event-location page that lists no events, and the page now says so. Source: UCSF-Bay Area Center for AIDS Research, 1700 Owens Street event location page (cfar.ucsf.edu/event-location/1700-owens-street).

item.title: Correction · 1700 Owens Street: 1700 Owens Street: no source read names a UCSF or university…
item.description: 1700 Owens Street: no source read names a UCSF or university occupant. The city permit calls it research and development with a proposed medical or dental use, and the Assessor lists a medical-dental office building. The CFAR page cited is only an event-location tag. Source: UCSF-Bay Area Center for AIDS Research event page (cfar.ucsf.edu/event-location/1700-owens-street); DataSF Building Permits i98e-djp9, permit 200412282235; DataSF Assessor secured roll wv5m-vpq2, parcel 8709007.

item.title: Correction · 1700 Owens Street: A claim that a Gladstone research center is housed in this…
item.description: A claim that a Gladstone research center is housed in this building was removed because the only page that supported it no longer exists. Source: Pier & Point editorial review.

item.title: Correction · 1700 Owens Street: The map notes said the construction date was not confirmed, though…
item.description: The map notes said the construction date was not confirmed, though the record cites a DBI permit completed 2007-10-02 and an Assessor year built of 2007, so both notes were corrected. The summary no longer says CFAR is based at 1700 Owens, since the cited page only lists CFAR events held there; the Taube-Koret Center for Huntington's Disease Research is now cited to Gladstone's own contact page, which places it in the 1700 building (the page is undated, so current occupancy is flagged unconfirmed). Source: DataSF Building Permits, permit #200412282235 (https://data.sf.gov/resource/i98e-djp9.json?permit_number=200412282235); DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls, parcel 8709007 (https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json); UCSF-Bay Area Center for AIDS Research, 1700 Owens Street event location (https://cfar.ucsf.edu/event-location/1700-owens-street); Gladstone Institutes, Taube-Koret Center for Huntington's Disease Research contact page (https://gladstone.org/sites/default/files/u/sfinkbeiner/taube-koret/Contact_Us.html).
